subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding that money is earned by doing work
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student completes a simple task (real or simulated chore) and 'earns' play money for it
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a job or chore to the idea of earning money for doing it
exercise.abstract: Student explains where money comes from before someone can spend it

misconception_flags: believes money simply appears without any work or exchange behind it

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
